deep.reconstruction: There is no mathematics on this page. It is the modern inside front cover (pastedown or endpaper) of the restored volume. It carries two items. (1) A pencil shelfmark in a modern library hand at the top: 'Cod. Ms. Gauß, Handb. 8', meaning Codex Manuscriptus Gauß, Handbuch 8, the Göttingen SUB signature of one of Gauss's notebooks ('Handbücher'). (2) A printed bookplate recording that the restoration was sponsored through the Göttingen State and University Library book-sponsorship programme: 'Restauriert dank freundlicher Unterstützung von Roswitha Brinkmann – www.sub.uni-goettingen.de/buchpatenschaft'. Nothing is derived or computed, and nothing is in Gauss's hand. The only historical information is the identification of the volume as Handbuch 8. That fits the bundle label HB.Aufsaetze1813, where HB = Handbuch.
deep.surprise_reason: This is a modern binding or restoration endpaper with only a library shelfmark and a sponsor's bookplate. It contains no mathematical content by Gauss.
transcription_corrections: The transcription matches the image. The first line is a pencil shelfmark added by the library, not Gauss's handwriting. 'Handb.' abbreviates 'Handbuch'.
